phase3_8_config.scope_decision: PROJECT_EXECUTION.md Task 3.8 lists 10 target intents. The frozen 1,932-question DEV corpus (results/phase_2_4_dev.json) has zero examples of numeric_narrative, narrative, or section_summary (verified by exhaustively counting every (category,subtype) shape present; src.eval.evaluation_dataset.build_narrative_record() exists but every record it produces stays status=pending_review and was never promoted into the eval set). User-approved (2026-09-12): build/evaluate the router on the 6 intents with real ground truth only (xbrl_fact, numeric_derived, cross_entity, unanswerable, out_of_scope, advice); the other 4 are designed-but-unevaluated pending new eval data, explicitly out of scope for this task.
phase3_8_config.ground_truth_source: Every DEV question record already carries an 'intent_label' field frozen at Task 2.3 generation time, matching this task's 6-intent scope exactly (xbrl_fact=1402, numeric_derived=244, unanswerable=139, cross_entity=105, out_of_scope=29, advice=13, total=1932) - reused verbatim as ground truth. No new labelled eval set was constructed; PROJECT_EXECUTION.md's 'build a labelled router evaluation set' is satisfied by this already-existing, already-frozen field.
phase3_8_config.eval_population: all 1932 DEV questions (not the 89-question retrieval scope - the router classifies EVERY DEV question by intent, including the ones Task 3.1 excluded from retrieval scoring for lacking an indexed gold document; intent classification does not require a retrievable target the way doc_recall does).
phase3_8_config.gazetteer_source: Built from the DEV question dataset's own structured fields (every question record's 'company'/'operands[].company' name + 'cik' pair, deduplicated) - not a new external company-master file. This is a legitimate stand-in for 'the system's known-company registry' for this evaluation; a production router would instead resolve against the full SEC company/CIK submissions list.
phase3_8_config.concept_registry_source: configs/eval_tags.yaml via src.eval.tag_registry (Task 2.2, frozen, 15 tags) - the ONLY source of known-XBRL-concept labels, never a second keyword list.
phase3_8_config.classifier: src.router.rules.classify_intent - deterministic cascade: prompt-injection keywords -> out_of_scope; financial-advice keywords -> advice; no resolvable company/fiscal-year/concept at all -> out_of_scope; comparative keyword + >=2 distinct companies resolved -> cross_entity; change/difference keyword + >=2 distinct fiscal years -> numeric_derived; fiscal year outside 2016-2020 -> unanswerable; no known XBRL concept matched -> unanswerable; else -> xbrl_fact. Keyword lists are deliberately generalizable phrase cues, never a memorized copy of src.eval.evaluation_dataset.ADVERSARIAL_TEMPLATES's 60 exact template strings.
phase3_8_config.llm_router_comparison: Not benchmarked in this round - PROJECT_EXECUTION.md: 'Benchmark an LLM router only if the rule baseline leaves meaningful gaps.' Whether the rule baseline's per-class metrics justify that follow-up is a decision for after this task's results are seen, not before.
phase3_8_config.metric_definitions: confusion matrix + per-class precision/recall/F1 + overall accuracy + macro-F1 via src.eval.phase3_router (new pure-logic module - Task 2.6's src.eval.metrics is retrieval-ranking/refusal-rate shaped, not multi-class-classification shaped, so this is a new metric family, not a duplicate).

ablation_row.notes: Task 3.8: rules-first router, 6-intent scope, accuracy=0.8582, macro_f1=0.8871 over 1932 DEV questions.

limitations: Scoped to 6 intents with real DEV ground truth - numeric_narrative, narrative, and section_summary have zero labeled examples anywhere in the DEV corpus and are designed-but-unevaluated (user-approved 2026-09-12).

Company gazetteer is built from the DEV question dataset's own embedded company/CIK fields, not an external SEC company-master registry - a legitimate stand-in for this evaluation, not a production-grade resolver.

Keyword-cue lists (injection/advice/comparative/derived) are hand-written generalizations, not tuned against a held-out set - the reported metrics are this rule set's true DEV performance, not an optimistic estimate from overfitting to templates.
No LLM router benchmarked in this round - deferred per the roadmap's own 'only if the rule baseline leaves meaningful gaps' condition.
next_task_readiness: Rule-based router accuracy=0.8582, macro_f1=0.8871 over 1932 DEV questions (6-intent scope).
